description_html: Setting reference: No Ethereal Plane (ethereal jaunt = intangible on Material Plane). No Astral Plane (astral projection travels to the Twisting Nether). Summon monster and planar anchor are Warlock-only and summon demons. Necromancy spells restricted to Necromancer (supplement). Lesser and greater planar ally summon elementals only. Divine casters draw power from philosophy and spirits, not domains.
